title: Chapter 948
paragraphs: Chapter 948
Episode 234. To Hell (8)
It was a blunder.
A serious mistake that the ordinarily calm Beradin would never have made had he stepped into the portal.

The demonic world is full of unknown dangers, not only occupied by Jito but also by Kelriak. There's no reason to cross a portal without any information, solely for the purpose of chasing Kinselo in such circumstances.
'I've been too blinded by trying to avoid the golden energy left by Jin Runkandel.'
Moreover, he even drove away Satrien and Phinia to avoid it.
The portal they just entered was closed, so there was no escape. Beradin, Betty, and Tuyan had to face Kelriak, the Demon Kings, and all their forces on their own.
"Traitor, Kelriak Ziphel...."

"Huhu, are you still trying to brand me as a traitor even here? Anyway, Tuyan is a dragon subjugated to you due to a contract, and the loyalty of that pathetic biological golem is absolute. Above all, didn't you commit treason, Beradin?"
"I had no idea you even captured Orgal. What did you promise him?"
Kelriak gave a meaningful smile.
"You think Orgal and Jephrin handed you over to me."
"Are you saying that's not the case?"
"That's why you're still not enough to be a sovereign, my son. I just used them, I didn't ask for their help by promising them a reward."
It was true.
Kelriak had merely predicted everything. When the hell's conquest of the in-law forces begins, Orgal and Jephrin will naturally search this vicinity first, and Beradin will surely chase after them.

"If you broke my prediction and didn't come here, I would have dealt with them first. I don't need any power other than the Ziphel in this world. Don't you know? The purpose of the family is simple. It's to become the only god of this world. So, Kinselo is still our enemy."
Beradin and Betty alternately stared at Kelriak and the giant fireball rising behind him like a sun, tensely.
"By the way, how was the gift I sent you? If our lost ancestor didn't help you, we would have had a more beautiful reunion by now."
"Don't mention Elona with that filthy mouth."
"Kuhaha.... What an interesting response. Beradin, my son. Why do you think I'm filthy?"
"What are you suddenly talking about?"
"Isn't it strange? If you despise me so much, you should also despise all the leaders of the family who have been assisting you so far. Octavia, Satrien, or Ronil."
"……What?"
"Think carefully about why you hate me."
The reason he hated Kelliac.
Ever since he became a head of the family, Veradin never really contemplated that issue.
There seemed to be no need to think about it. Deposing the then weak and collapsing Kelliac and becoming the head of the family himself seemed simply natural.

But in truth, Veradin had hated Kelliac from the depths of his heart since that moment. He wanted to erase Kelliac's name from the family as soon as possible. That's why he reacted sensitively to issues related to Kelliac.
Suddenly, Veradin felt his head go blank.
Mind control.
And the vengeance for that pain.
The grudge Veradin held against Kelliac all stemmed from the mind control.
But back then, it wasn't just Kelliac who participated in Veradin's mind control.

"All the main members of the family were involved in your mind control back then. So why is your grudge only against me? You could have easily avenged them by tearing them apart with the power you have now."
"That's because……!"

"Because the family would weaken if you dealt with them? That was wrong from the moment you betrayed me. You should know better than anyone. If you had chosen to merge with me, not betray me, the family would have been stronger than ever."
"Urgh!"
Holding his head, Veradin swayed. A severe pain, like his brain was being torn apart, was looming in his head.
"Head of the family!"
Unable to turn around, Betty could only yell. The only reason Betty could worry about Veradin like that was that Kelliac still wanted to converse with him more.
"Even the guardian dragon carrying you on its back, Tuyan, participated in the mind control. You have been ignoring this uncomfo
rtable truth all this time, son."
"Kuh…… Hah."
"But, what could be the reason you could only do that? Why did you ignore your anger at the others who participated in the mind control, and only obsessed over your father?"
Unable to answer, Veradin glared at Kelliac.
His vision was already blurring f
rom the pain. His shaky legs seemed ready to give way at any moment.
"Since you don't seem to know, let me tell you the reason now. Listen carefully, it's because……."
It's because you're a failure, son.
Kelliac slowly added the last words, as if savoring a delicacy.
"Shut up!"
"There's no other reason. You're just behaving strangely because you're a failure."
"Shut up!"
Veradin clenched his teeth and reached out his Huroti.
However, magic did not accumulate in Huroti. It felt as if a solid wall was blocking in all directions, and the magic power was not flowing in at all.

"Everything you have is originally mine. Your magic, your position, your life…… it's natural and logical that you can't use anything to your liking without my permission. It's taken too long to get to this point."
Veradin tried to gather his magic power again, but it was the same. Rather, it felt like his whole body was choked by a rope every time he tried to use his magic.
Kelriak was controlling his magic power using the 'part of his physic
al body' that was left in Veradin and the curse he set before starting the psychic manipulation.
Psychic manipulation always has to be prepared for the target's rampage. Of course, Kelriak continued the experiment with a safety device in place for that.
At the time when Veradin betrayed him, he was not in a state to use that safety device. That's why the throne was so vainly taken from Veradin.
It's not like that now. Kelriak was able to tie up Veradin's magic power so easily.
"Do you understand now, Veradin. You were just a spare body for me. Just like the many bio-golems you've created...... your life has never been yours."
Shrrrr-!
Veradin pulled out his sword, stumbling. As the aura was a power newly gained after his body was modified by a shamaness and sanctuary, Kelriak could not control it at will.
But even the aura didn't rise as much as he wanted.
"Hey, son of my friend Kelriak. It would be better not to take out the aura if you're not as strong as your monster friends. You shouldn't look down on the poison of our extreme poison area."
Ragal said.
As soon as he saw Veradin trying to use his aura, he activated all the poison he had hidden throughout the Extreme Poison Area.

Even Betty, who is in much better condition than Veradin now, was having trouble breathing due to the poison. Betty could fight at a level similar to usual, but it was hard for Veradin to even stand now.
"I want to eat you as you are, but I'll stop here for the sake of my friend Kelriak's face. Um, I shouldn't discipline other people's children rashly."
In the end, Veradin had no choice but to face it.
The fact that there was no way for him to survive here.
Just like Kelriak lost everything due to a single mistake, the variable of psychic manipulation, now it was his turn to fall due to a single mistake of crossing the dimensional gate.
"Betty…… Betty Zifl."
"Lord, please speak……!"
"Run away…… Leave me behind."
"No, I can't!"
Of course, Betty refused.
However, Veradin began to recite the trigger word for the magic he had put on Betty, just like Kellick was doing to him right now.
It was a kind of safety device designed to ensure that Betty, in any situation, no matter how strong her ego became, would definitely carry out Veradin's orders.
"Lord, please!"
"Take Huroti. Activate Huroti's signal and let Lady Elona know about this. If you survive and complete this task, then live your life from then on. I'm sorry, Betty."
"Lord!"
The trigger word was all spoken.
Suddenly, Betty became dull-eyed and recited Veradin's last command. Then, she immediately took Huroti and jumped off the turret.
Of course, there's no place for Betty to run.
Veradin just thought that was the best thing he could do for Betty. Betty was probably going to die here with him.
So Elona will hear about this later, and she will surely seek Kellick for revenge...
Veradin wanted Elona to just forget everything and go away. But he couldn't tell her that.
"Ha! Kellick, my friend, I can't see because I'm tearful. You've raised your son well!"

"Don't worry, son. Neither you nor your precious biogolems will die and disappear here today. You will simply be subjugated back to me as my spare, and the biogolems will be modified for necessary work. Tuyan, your fate will be decided depending on the attitude of your god."
As Kellick lifted his staff, a fireball began to spew out thousands of branches of fire all around.
Veradin looked at the flames filling beyond Tuyan's shield and briefly looked back on his past days.
First, the face of Elona Jiffle came to mind. He seemed to hear the voice saying thank you for re-etching the meaning of life.

Then, the biogolems came to mind. He shivered at the fact that what he did to them was not much different from what Kellick did to him. It would never have happened if the mind control didn't break his inner self.
Last thing he remembered was his friends.
He could see the backs of Jin and Dante. Only now that his mind was clear, he realized again that they were his most precious people, but it was too late.
'I can't even say goodbye properly. I'm sorry, everyone. You'll only remember my horrific appearance as the Lord of Jiffle.'
[Hey, what's that.]
Suddenly, an unexpected voice came. A voice that didn't fit at all with the memories he was recalling in his short time before death.
[Isn't that Veradin Jiffle? Huh? What are these guys doing here?]
The voice was not something Veradin was thinking in his mind, it was actually ringing in the battlefield.
It was Murakan's voice.
